title: Tamil Months
label: ch:ta-tamil-months
canDo: I can name the twelve months of the Tamil solar calendar and place Tamil New Year and Pongal inside it.

payoff.summary: Complete TA-C16-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: say the twelve months from Chithirai to Panguṉi, place Tamil New Year and Pongal, say why ஆம் opens on a full vowel letter, then write ம, ஆ and ஆம் from sound.
payoff.note: TA-C16-checkpoint (sequence 615, TA-PATH-022 order 1, after TA-S120-letter-aa and before chapter 17's first lesson) assesses all six atoms the chapter introduces (6/6). It is the payoff because four of them, ம (TA-S07-ma, 605), independent ஆ and ஆம் (TA-W05-write-aam, 610) and ஆ (TA-S120-letter-aa, 611), are taught after the spoken lesson TA-C16-thamizh-maadangal (600), which could honestly assess only the months (2/6); that lesson stays as the chapter's spoken lesson. The script lessons sit on the earlier TA-PATH-003 and TA-PATH-100 segments, so the checkpoint comes after all of them on the sequence and on the path.
